title: mollia lepidota subsp. boliviana
intro: Mollia lepidota subsp. boliviana, commonly known as Bolivian tree heath, is a plant species in the family Ericaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mollia lepidota subsp. boliviana include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating infections and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
